name: Complete pc-Minimal Obstructions to Dismantlable Ampleness
statement: A finite partial cube is dismantlable ample exactly when it has no pc-minor isomorphic to an antipodally punctured cube $Q_n^{--}$, $n\ge3$, and no pc-minor whose Yang complex is a color-minimal nonshellable constructible ball. The punctured cubes are exactly the nonample pc-minimal obstructions; the color-minimal Yang balls are exactly the ample pc-minimal obstructions.
proof: Every nonample partial cube contains an antipodally punctured cube as a pc-minor; pc-minimality therefore makes these and only these the nonample basis layer. For an ample family, the Alexander-dual ideal has a linear resolution, and dismantlable ampleness is equivalent to linear quotients. The two restrictions and one contraction in each color give exactly the elementary pc-minors. Thus an ample failure is pc-minimal precisely when its ideal lacks linear quotients but all $3d$ one-color images have them, equivalently when its Yang ball is nonshellable but all literal links and color-pair deletions are shellable. Pc-minor closure reduces every proper minor to one of these elementary images.
comments: The ample layer is parametrized exactly by a finite set of algebraic or shellability tests in each fixed coordinate dimension. Hall's class is a named member of this general family; an enumeration by elementary named graph constructions remains a separate problem.
